name: order-history-exporter
description: Expense Hub: a self-hosted app for business expenses, with a Chrome extension that syncs store orders.

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.server: npm run build && npm start -w server
scripts.test: npm run build -w server && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test tests/unit.test.js tests/server.test.js tests/auth.test.js tests/bank.test.js
